# AnisotropicTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A network topology whose connectivity or coupling strengths vary by direction rather than remaining uniform and isotropic. It is central to TCC because directional topology governs information propagation, causality, and filtering in physical networks.
